when: The opening cover page — a LINEAR stack, not a card grid.
notes: The reference lays the cover out in source order: a `.source-front-title` masthead carrying `.chapter-badge` and `.chapter-topic`, then one `.source-front-section` per `##` analytics heading. A table inside a section takes one of two skins, picked by shape rather than by heading text: `.priority-table` for a ranked value column (each row a `.priority-topic` with its `.priority-id` chip and a `.count-value` pill) and `.study-table` for a numbered procedure (a `.study-number` circle per row). The older ~60 `cv*` classes are no longer emitted.
